WITH account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
avg_trans_per_account AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(transaction_count AS REAL)) as avg_transaction_count
  FROM account_stats
)
SELECT 
  a.account_id,
  a.avg_amount,
  a.transaction_count,
  CAST(a.transaction_count AS REAL) / atp.avg_transaction_count as ratio
FROM account_stats a
CROSS JOIN avg_trans_per_account atp
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
